mentions.name: Short Game Wiz
mentions.description: A golf performance tracking app that picks up where Arccos leaves off, analyzing rounds to surface weaknesses like right-to-left breaking putts, uphill putts, and bunker saves, and telling golfers what to practice.
mentions.problem: Existing golf tracking apps like Arccos leave off before providing the deeper short-game insights needed to reach a single-digit handicap.
mentions.audience: Data-obsessed golfers trying to get to a single-digit handicap.
mentions.source_excerpt: I need a tracking app that picks up where Arccos leaves off. So I'm building one: https://shortgamewiz.com (still a bit WIP).

evidence.value: I need a tracking app that picks up where Arccos leaves off. So I'm building one: https://shortgamewiz.com (still a bit WIP).
